title: Galactic Mandate 08
content:
Galactic Mandate Linux is an Ubuntu-based Linux distribution featuring the Budgie desktop and a science fiction theme. It includes book-cover themes, live system telemetry, themed applications, alert modes, visual file tools, and practical Linux software, such as Firefox and OnlyOffice delivered as flatpak packages. The distribution is developed by M. R. Richardson, a science fiction writer and author of the Galactic Mandate series of science fiction books.
